summary: The PWS-MD customer, vendor and item/service read-first specs now require at least five screenshot checkpoints before their screenshot QA is accepted. This makes the next real playthru UI observation less likely to misread Business Central from a single end screenshot.
actionsTaken: Re-read the durable project objective and confirmed active truth remains playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Raised PWS-MD-001, PWS-MD-002 and PWS-MD-003 screenshot QA from three accepted screenshots to at least five accepted checkpoints.
Added explicit route-decision screenshots so direct-page success and fallback navigation are both documented instead of inferred.
Added no-write end-context screenshots after Page Inspection to prove the read-first run finishes without an intended edit/write state.
Kept the change local to Playwright spec logic; no Playwright live run was executed.

warnings: Refresh Playwright auth in the Playwright-managed profile before any live BC/Playwright run.
Run exactly one read-first/no-write Master Data pilot at a time after auth is green and Foundation gates still allow it.

Use real Business Central UI evidence and customer-project-like Universaarl records; do not use UI mockups, throwaway dummy data or confidential real customer data.

nextStepDecision.reason: Foundation Readiness remains the handoff, but Master Data read-first page claims now need stronger screenshot QA before they can become evidence.
nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It keeps live work behind auth and screenshot gates while making the next real Master Data observation less ambiguous and more visually reviewable.
